text:
sara: Morning — quick ask: vendor (Spectra) says they can free 2x A100 slots in us-west2 for ~4h starting 08:00 PT. Can we take them for the demo canary? Need a terraform quiet-window + AMI smoke. Any conflicts?

kai: I have a small perf sweep at 09:00 PT for hf models. Can move to 11:00 PT if we need the slots. Who owns the TF lock window?

ajay: ops handles the lock. @tess can you approve a 2h quiet window? We'll only apply minimal tag changes.

tess: +1 for 08:00-10:00 PT if ajay's good. What's the exact bake? Any risky post-install steps?

sara: Bake is the canary AMI v2026.03. Minor startup script changes only. No network changes. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3344

devops-bot: PR 3344 touched module/gpu_pool.tf — terraform plan shows 2 reserved slots -> vendor_pool-uswest2. No drifts detected.

matt: Quick flag — billing alert threshold for burst pools is $1,200/day. 4h should be fine but tagging is important.

kai: LGTM from me if I can move my perf job. I'll shift it now and post the new cron.

ajay: I'll create the TF lock and set the scheduler quiet window once we confirm. @sara please add exact instance IDs to the PR so we can pin.

tess: Added a short smoke test to canary run to validate KV cache warmup and perf baseline. I'll watch logs during the window.

sara: Vendor contact: julia@spectra.com, +1-555-0102. I'll DM to confirm start time and exact instance serials. :thumbsup:

matt: also adding cost-center tag `cost:demo-Q2` to the PR for chargeback.

devops-bot: Lock created by ajay at 1719123500 for window 08:00-10:00 PT. Lock ID: L-37b8

kai: perf job updated to 11:00 PT and pushed. Commit: a1b2c3f.

sara: Thanks team — I'll lock in the vendor and follow up if the ETA shifts. Will post when vendor confirms provisioning. :rocket:
